$comment: The differences the migration is allowed to make, each with the reason it is a
rendering change and not a copy change. The value on every entry is the string
the built page printed or stopped printing, byte for byte, which is why this file
holds some of the site's own em dashes: it quotes frozen copy exactly rather
than paraphrasing it, because an expectation that does not match is a rule that
fires on nothing. A route of "*" covers the same difference on every route,
which is what a chrome change is.
